tools.description: List the user's trips (not the ones in the bin), with their dates, each day's place and time zone (days), and whether you may change their contents (canEditContent: events, legs, to-dos, shopping, markers, attachments, notes) and the trip's own details (canEditTripInfo: name, dates, each day's place and time zone). Also tells you which trip is the default for this link.
tools.name: list_trips

tools.description: Read one trip: name, dates (or day count when undecided), days (one entry per day: day number, date when the dates are decided, place {name, detail} or null, and timeZone, the IANA zone that day is read in), place and timeZone of the whole trip (day 1's, kept for older instructions; prefer days), and whether you may change its contents (canEditContent) and its own details (canEditTripInfo). Leave tripId out to read the default trip.
tools.name: get_trip

tools.description: Find a place for a day of a trip: a city, region or island area (not a shop or an address). Returns candidates with a placeId, a name, a detail line (region and country) and the place's time zone. Pass the placeId in the days of create_trip or update_trip. Places that span several time zones (a whole large country) are not offered; pick a city in it instead.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "Kyoto" or "Okinawa".

tools.name: search_trip_place

tools.description: Create a new trip. Give it a name and either startDate + endDate (YYYY-MM-DD) or, when the dates are not decided yet, dayCount (1-300). A trip lasts 1 to 300 days. Every day has its own place and time zone: prefer days, one entry per day in day order (its length equals the number of days), each { placeId from search_trip_place, timeZone? }. A day without a placeId is refused, and the error lists which days. timeZone is { mode: followPlace | followPhone | custom, timeZone: IANA id for custom }; leave it out and the day follows its place (the phone when the place has no single zone). For compatibility with older instructions, a single placeId (or placeName) with an optional timeZone, without days, means every day has that place and zone; passing both days and those is refused. The new trip becomes the default for calls without tripId, and the trip the phone shows. The free plan holds 3 trips; when they are used up this fails and the user has to upgrade to Premium in the app on their phone.

dayCount.description: Number of days when the dates are undecided. Instead of startDate/endDate.

days.description: One entry per day, in day order: the length equals the trip's number of days. Every day needs a place.

placeId.description: The day's place: a placeId from search_trip_place. Required.

timeZone.description: The day's time zone. Leave out to follow the day's place (the phone's zone when the place has no single zone).
IANA identifier such as Asia/Tokyo. Only with mode custom. The app offers one zone per UTC offset (Seoul is Asia/Tokyo); a wrong one is refused with the list.

endDate.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Pass with startDate.

placeId.description: Compatibility with older instructions; prefer days. A placeId from search_trip_place that every day gets. Without days.

placeName.description: Compatibility with older instructions; prefer days. A place by name (the first search_trip_place match) that every day gets. Instead of placeId, without days.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Pass with endDate.

timeZone.description: Compatibility with older instructions; prefer days. The time zone every day gets, with placeId or placeName. Without days.
IANA identifier such as Asia/Tokyo. Only with mode custom.

tools.name: create_trip

tools.description: Change a trip's name, schedule, or each day's place and time zone. Pass only what changes; fields equal to what the trip already has are left alone. Leave tripId out for the default trip. Schedule: startDate + endDate (YYYY-MM-DD), or dayCount (1-300) for undecided dates. Events are kept by day number, not by date: moving the start from Jul 1 to Jul 3 moves day 1's events to Jul 3. Shortening a trip deletes nothing; events on the days beyond the new end are hidden and come back if the trip is made longer again. The result's hiddenEventCount is how many events this change hid and reappearedEventCount how many hidden ones it brought back (0 when the day count did not change). When hiddenEventCount is above 0, always tell the user: those events are not deleted, the phone no longer shows them in the trip or the overview, they are listed in the trip's "Trip details" (旅程資訊 on a Chinese phone), the first step of editing the trip, and making the trip longer again brings them back; list_events marks them hiddenBeyondTripEnd. Places and time zones are per day: prefer days, which replaces all of them at once, one { placeId from search_trip_place, timeZone? } per day in day order, its length equal to the trip's number of days after this change; a day without a placeId is refused and the error lists which days. For compatibility with older instructions, a single placeId (or placeName) with an optional timeZone, without days, means every day gets that place and zone; passing both is refused, and clearPlace is refused because every day needs a place. timeZone is { mode: followPlace | followPhone | custom, timeZone: IANA id for custom }; leave it out and the day follows its place. Change only the dates or the day count and leave days out, and the days follow the app's rules: a longer trip copies the last day (its zone mode too) onto the new days, a shorter one drops the last days (a dropped day that has events keeps its place for when the trip is lengthened again). Changing a time zone moves no event. Only the trip's owner may change these: a trip shared with the user by someone else is refused.

dayCount.description: Number of days when the dates are undecided. Instead of startDate/endDate.

days.description: One entry per day, in day order: the length equals the trip's number of days. Every day needs a place.

placeId.description: The day's place: a placeId from search_trip_place. Required.

timeZone.description: The day's time zone. Leave out to follow the day's place (the phone's zone when the place has no single zone).
IANA identifier such as Asia/Tokyo. Only with mode custom. The app offers one zone per UTC offset (Seoul is Asia/Tokyo); a wrong one is refused with the list.

endDate.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Pass with startDate.

placeId.description: Compatibility with older instructions; prefer days. A placeId from search_trip_place that every day gets. Without days.

placeName.description: Compatibility with older instructions; prefer days. A place by name (the first search_trip_place match) that every day gets. Instead of placeId, without days.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Pass with endDate.

timeZone.description: Compatibility with older instructions; prefer days. The time zone every day gets, with placeId or placeName. Without days.
IANA identifier such as Asia/Tokyo. Only with mode custom.

tools.name: update_trip

tools.description: List a trip's events (the itinerary), day by day, with the leg (how you travel there) into each one. Times are HH:mm in the time zone of the day the event is on (each timed event carries it as timeZone; the trip's days list them too), as the app shows them; an event recorded in another time zone (a flight) also carries its own recorded times. Leave tripId out for the default trip. from / to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) narrow it to those dates; unscheduled events without a day are only listed when neither is given. Each event has: id, title, type, kind (timed, allDay or unscheduled), date and dayNumber (day 1 is the first day), startTime/endTime with a dayOffset when they fall on another calendar day, place, notes, cancelled, todoCount, attachmentCount, leg (into this event: fromEventId, mode, minutes, note…) and closingLeg (from this event to the day's closing all-day event).

from.description: First date to list, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

to.description: Last date to list, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

tools.name: list_events

tools.description: Find a place for an event or a custom map marker: a shop, a sight, a station, a hotel or an address (a trip's places come from search_trip_place instead). Uses the same search as the app's event form. By default it looks around the place of day 1; pass dayNumber (or date) to look around that day's place, or near (latitude/longitude, e.g. the previous event's place) to look around there instead. Returns candidates with a placeId, name, address, coordinates and suggestedType (the event type the app would pick for it when the event is titled with the place's name). Pass the placeId to create_event, update_event, create_marker or update_marker; placeIds last for this link only. If the candidates look unrelated, retry with the place's English or local-language name.

date.description: Lean towards the place of this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Instead of dayNumber. Optional.

dayNumber.description: Lean towards the place of this day (day 1 is the first day). Default: day 1. Optional.

near.description: Look around this point instead of a day's place.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "Kiyomizu-dera" or an address.

tripId.description: Trip id whose place the search leans towards. Optional.

tools.name: search_place

tools.description: Add an event to a trip's itinerary. Leave tripId out for the default trip. Kinds: a timed event (date or dayNumber, startTime, and endTime or durationMinutes; one hour by default), an all-day event (allDay: true, date or dayNumber, and endDate/endDayNumber for a span of days), or an unscheduled event (unscheduled: true; optional durationMinutes, optional day it belongs to). Day 1 is the trip's first day; a trip with undecided dates only takes dayNumber. Days must be inside the trip, as in the app's form. Times are HH:mm in the that day's time zone unless you pass eventTimeZone / endTimeZone (IANA), which records the event in that zone and reads the times there (a flight leaving Taipei and landing in Tokyo: eventTimeZone Asia/Taipei, endTimeZone Asia/Tokyo). An event that ends after midnight takes endDate/endDayNumber. Place: placeId from search_place (also fills the title and the type when you leave them out), or placeName for a name only (an address-looking name is located on the map, like typing it in the app). Leave type out and the app picks one from the title as its form does: the type it is sure of, else the place's category, else other (a title other than the place's name can differ from search_place's suggestedType; pass type to be sure).

allDay.description: true: an all-day event over one or more days.

date.description: The day it is on, YYYY-MM-DD. Or dayNumber.

dayNumber.description: The day it is on; day 1 is the trip's first day. Or date.

durationMinutes.description: How long it takes: the length of a timed event (instead of endTime), or of an unscheduled one.

endDate.description: Last day of an all-day event, or the day a timed event ends on when it ends after midnight. YYYY-MM-DD.

endDayNumber.description: Same as endDate, as a day number.

endTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the end, when it differs from the start (a flight).

eventTimeZone.description: IANA time zone the event is recorded in (default: the trip's). startTime/endTime are then read in it.

notes.description: Notes: booking numbers, reminders. Empty string clears them.

placeName.description: A place by name only, as typed in the app. Instead of placeId.

type.description: Event type. sight, dining, transport, lodging and other are the broad ones.

unscheduled.description: true: no day or time decided yet (a day it belongs to is optional).

tools.name: create_event

tools.description: Change an event. Pass eventId and only what changes; everything else stays as it is, and a call that changes nothing writes nothing. Same fields as create_event, plus clearPlace: true to remove the place and cancelled (true marks "not going": it stays on the calendar struck through and leaves the route; false brings it back). Times you pass are read in the trip's time zone unless you pass eventTimeZone / endTimeZone. Moving to another date keeps its times. Switch kinds with allDay or unscheduled (true or false). Its leg and closing leg stay; change those with set_leg / clear_leg.

allDay.description: true: an all-day event over one or more days.

cancelled.description: true: not going (reversible). false: going again.

date.description: The day it is on, YYYY-MM-DD. Or dayNumber.

dayNumber.description: The day it is on; day 1 is the trip's first day. Or date.

durationMinutes.description: How long it takes: the length of a timed event (instead of endTime), or of an unscheduled one.

endDate.description: Last day of an all-day event, or the day a timed event ends on when it ends after midnight. YYYY-MM-DD.

endDayNumber.description: Same as endDate, as a day number.

endTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the end, when it differs from the start (a flight).

eventTimeZone.description: IANA time zone the event is recorded in (default: the trip's). startTime/endTime are then read in it.

notes.description: Notes: booking numbers, reminders. Empty string clears them.

placeName.description: A place by name only, as typed in the app. Instead of placeId.

type.description: Event type. sight, dining, transport, lodging and other are the broad ones.

unscheduled.description: true: no day or time decided yet (a day it belongs to is optional).

tools.name: update_event

tools.description: Delete an event, with its to-dos and attachments, and clear the leg of the event after it that started from it. This cannot be undone from here. To keep it but mark "not going", use update_event with cancelled: true instead.
tools.name: delete_event

tools.description: Set how the traveller gets to an event: the leg into eventId (the event you travel TO). It starts from the event before it on the same day, or from fromEventId when you pass one (needed for an all-day event, e.g. the day's closing hotel). Pass only what changes; the rest of an existing leg stays. mode: idle (free time, not travelling), walking, driving, cycling, transit or other. transitKind (bus, train, ferry, airplane) and runs (scheduled departures) only apply to transit; avoidsHighways only to driving. durationMinutes is the travel time the user knows (0 clears it and it reads back as null; the app estimates one from the map otherwise). routeUrl must be an http(s) link.

eventId.description: The event you travel to (from list_events).

fromEventId.description: The event you leave from. Optional.

note.description: e.g. "take the 8:15 one". Empty string clears it.

routeUrl.description: A route page (http/https). Empty string clears it.

runs.description: Transit departures to choose from. Replaces the existing list.

selectedRunIndex.description: Which run in runs is the one to take.

tools.name: set_leg

tools.description: Remove the leg into eventId (how the traveller gets there). For the leg into the day's closing all-day event, pass fromEventId too. The events stay.

eventId.description: The event you travel to (from list_events).

fromEventId.description: The event you leave from. Optional.

tools.name: clear_leg

tools.description: List a trip's to-dos. A to-do is either on an event (eventId) or an "important" one that belongs to the whole trip (eventId null, shown on the trip's overview). Leave tripId out for the default trip; pass eventId to list only that event's to-dos.
tools.name: list_todos

tools.description: Add a to-do. With eventId it goes on that event; without, it is an important to-do of the whole trip. It is added at the end of its list, not done unless done: true.

eventId.description: Event id from list_events. Leave out for an important to-do.

tools.name: create_todo

tools.description: Change a to-do's text or tick it done / not done. Only what you pass changes; passing what it already has writes nothing.
tools.name: update_todo

tools.description: Delete a to-do. This cannot be undone from here.
tools.name: delete_todo

tools.description: List a trip's shopping list: each item's name, notes, reference price and currency, categories, status (pending / bought / skipped), what was paid, whether it is private, the events it can be bought at, and its price-comparison quotes. Leave tripId out for the default trip.
tools.name: list_shopping_items

tools.description: Add an item to a trip's shopping list. It is added at the end, private and not bought yet unless you say otherwise. A price without a currency uses the currency the user picked in the app.

categories.description: Categories, in order. An item can have several.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the price, e.g. JPY. Default: the currency the user picked in the app.

detail.description: Notes: where to buy it, which branch, what to look out for.

eventIds.description: Events (from list_events) where it can be bought.

paidCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of paidPrice when it differs from the price's currency.

paidPrice.description: What was actually paid. Only on a bought item.

private.description: Only matters on a shared trip: private items are not shown to the others. New items are private.

status.description: pending: still to buy; skipped: decided not to buy.

tools.name: create_shopping_item

tools.description: Change a shopping item. Only what you pass changes; null clears price, currency, detail or paidPrice; categories and eventIds replace the whole list. Moving it off "bought" clears what was paid. Passing what it already has writes nothing. Quotes and photos are only changed in the app.

categories.description: Categories, in order. An item can have several.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the price, e.g. JPY. Default: the currency the user picked in the app.

detail.description: Notes: where to buy it, which branch, what to look out for.

eventIds.description: Events (from list_events) where it can be bought.

paidCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of paidPrice when it differs from the price's currency.

paidPrice.description: What was actually paid. Only on a bought item.

private.description: Only matters on a shared trip: private items are not shown to the others. New items are private.

status.description: pending: still to buy; skipped: decided not to buy.

tools.name: update_shopping_item

tools.description: Delete a shopping item with its photos and quotes. This cannot be undone from here. To keep it but not buy it, set status skipped instead.
tools.name: delete_shopping_item

tools.description: List a trip's custom map markers: places the user wants to go to but has not put on a day yet. Each has a name, a point, an optional type and notes. Leave tripId out for the default trip.
tools.name: list_markers

tools.description: Put a custom marker on the trip's map. It needs a point: pass placeId from search_place (its point and name are used), or latitude and longitude. A name alone is not enough — call search_place first. name overrides the place's name.

name.description: Marker name. Default: the place's name.

type.description: What kind of place it is (the same types as events).

tools.name: create_marker

tools.description: Change a custom marker. Only what you pass changes; null clears type or notes. To move it, pass a new placeId from search_place (its name is kept unless you pass name). Passing what it already has writes nothing.

name.description: Marker name. Default: the place's name.

type.description: What kind of place it is (the same types as events).

tools.name: update_marker

tools.description: Delete a custom marker from the trip's map. This cannot be undone from here.
tools.name: delete_marker

tools.description: List a trip's attachments (files and links). One attachment can hang in several places, so the same id can appear on several rows; "attachedTo" says where each row hangs: the trip itself ("trip", shown as the trip's important attachments), an event ("event"), or the leg into an event ("leg", with the event travelled from). Important ones come first, then by the itinerary. Pass eventId to list only what hangs on that event and on the leg into it.
tools.name: list_attachments

tools.description: Attach a small file (up to 5 MB after decoding) given as base64. Without eventId it is attached to the trip itself (the trip's important attachments); with eventId it hangs on that event. For a file on the computer, or anything over 5 MB: if you have add_attachment_from_path (only when connected through the TripEZGo bridge), use it with the file's path (up to 20 MB, the app's limit for one attachment). Otherwise ask the user to make the file smaller than 5 MB, or to connect with the Claude Desktop setup, which goes through the bridge.

base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. At most 5 MB decoded.

eventId.description: Event id from list_events. Leave out to attach to the trip.

name.description: File name with its extension, e.g. ticket.pdf.

tools.name: add_attachment

tools.description: Take an attachment off one place. Without eventId that place is the trip itself; with eventId it is that event, and with eventId plus fromEventId it is the leg from fromEventId into eventId. If the attachment still hangs somewhere else it stays there; if this was its last place the file itself is deleted and cannot be brought back. There is no way to delete a file outright.

eventId.description: The event it hangs on. Leave out for the trip itself.

fromEventId.description: With eventId: the leg from this event into eventId.

tools.name: detach_attachment

tools.description: List a trip's notes, most recently changed first: id, title, whether it is private (only the user sees it; a shared one is seen by everyone on a shared trip), when it last changed, and its first line. Notes in the trash are not listed. Use get_note to read one.
tools.name: list_notes

tools.description: Read one note: its title and its content as Markdown. Markdown subset, one line per paragraph: "## " a heading line, "### " a second-level heading line, "- " a list item, any other line plain text (start it with "\" if it would otherwise look like one of those). Notes have no check items: "- [ ] " / "- [x] " is refused — make a to-do with create_todo instead. A photo is a line "[image:<id>]". A mention (the app's @name link to an event or a shopping item of this trip) is "[mention:event:<eventId>|<name>]" or "[mention:shoppingItem:<itemId>|<name>]" inside a line, with "\" before any "]" or "\" in the name; to add one use an id from list_events or list_shopping_items. Bold and italics are not expressed; lines you leave unchanged keep theirs.
tools.name: get_note

tools.description: Write a new note in the trip. title is required; markdown is the content. Markdown subset, one line per paragraph: "## " a heading line, "### " a second-level heading line, "- " a list item, any other line plain text (start it with "\" if it would otherwise look like one of those). Notes have no check items: "- [ ] " / "- [x] " is refused — make a to-do with create_todo instead. A photo is a line "[image:<id>]". A mention (the app's @name link to an event or a shopping item of this trip) is "[mention:event:<eventId>|<name>]" or "[mention:shoppingItem:<itemId>|<name>]" inside a line, with "\" before any "]" or "\" in the name; to add one use an id from list_events or list_shopping_items. Bold and italics are not expressed; lines you leave unchanged keep theirs. A new note is private unless isPrivate is false. Photos cannot be added from here.

isPrivate.description: Only the user sees it. Default true.

markdown.description: The content, in the Markdown subset described above.

tools.name: create_note

tools.description: Change a note's title, content or privacy. Only what you pass changes; passing what it already has writes nothing. markdown replaces the whole content: start from get_note's markdown and keep every [image:<id>] line you do not mean to remove — leaving one out deletes that photo, and an id the note does not have is refused. Keep every [mention:...] placeholder you do not mean to remove the same way: leaving one out removes that mention. Markdown subset, one line per paragraph: "## " a heading line, "### " a second-level heading line, "- " a list item, any other line plain text (start it with "\" if it would otherwise look like one of those). Notes have no check items: "- [ ] " / "- [x] " is refused — make a to-do with create_todo instead. A photo is a line "[image:<id>]". A mention (the app's @name link to an event or a shopping item of this trip) is "[mention:event:<eventId>|<name>]" or "[mention:shoppingItem:<itemId>|<name>]" inside a line, with "\" before any "]" or "\" in the name; to add one use an id from list_events or list_shopping_items. Bold and italics are not expressed; lines you leave unchanged keep theirs.
tools.name: update_note

tools.description: Move a note to the trash. It stays there for 30 days, and the user can bring it back from the notes trash in the app's Settings until then; after that it is gone.
tools.name: delete_note

tools.description: List a trip's inspirations, newest first: things the user saved from other apps (a link, a piece of text, photos or files) that are not yet decided. Each shows its title, link and source, categories (image / place / text / link; one can be several, and link means it has a web address), event type, place, whether the user has read it, whether it is linked (it was turned into something in the trip that still exists and the user can see, listed under destinations), and whether it is private. Linked is worked out, not set: once everything it was turned into is deleted it is unlinked again. Filter like the app's filter bar: status (default all), categories (any of them) and types. Leave tripId out for the default trip.

categories.description: Only inspirations in any of these categories.

status.description: unlinked: not turned into anything that still exists; linked: it is; all: both. Default all.

types.description: Only inspirations of these event types (one with no type chosen counts as other).

tools.name: list_inspirations

tools.description: Read one inspiration in full: everything list_inspirations shows plus the whole text that came with it, its photos and files (names and sizes; their contents are not readable here) and how it was added. Reading it here does not mark it read; use set_inspiration_read for that.
tools.name: get_inspiration

tools.description: Save a new inspiration in a trip, the way the app's "add inspiration" sheet does: content is a link or a piece of text. Text with a web link in it saves that link and keeps the whole text as its description; text without one saves the text (first line as title). It is saved as read, not linked, private. The app fetches the page's title, picture and place, and picks a type when none is given, in the background a moment later. Photos and files cannot be added here.

content.description: A link, or text (a link inside it is picked up).

type.description: Event type. Leave it out and the app picks one when it reads the page.

tools.name: create_inspiration

tools.description: Mark an inspiration read or unread for the user (the app's unread badge counts the unread ones). Read marks are the user's own: on a shared trip the others keep theirs, and it works even on a trip the user cannot change.
tools.name: set_inspiration_read

tools.description: Turn an inspiration into something in the trip, as the app's "Add to…" does; afterwards it is read and linked, and records where it went (it stays linked while that thing exists). It can be added again elsewhere. Destinations: event — a new event with its title, type, place, description and link, and its photos, files or page picture as attachments; with no time given it goes into the first free slot the app would pick (or the unscheduled list when none is free); or pass date/dayNumber with startTime and endTime or durationMinutes (that day's time zone), or unscheduled: true. note — a private note with its photos (or page picture), description and link. shopping — a private item to buy; needs a name or a picture. attachment — its link (as a link attachment), photos and files, plus a link's saved page picture, on the event eventId, or as the trip's key attachments without eventId; text only does not fit. marker — a map marker at its place, or at where its photos were taken; needs a place or a photo. One that does not fit the destination is refused with the reason. To-dos are not a destination.

date.description: event only: the day, YYYY-MM-DD. Or dayNumber.

dayNumber.description: event only: the day; day 1 is the trip's first day. Or date.

durationMinutes.description: event only: how long, instead of endTime.

endTime.description: event only: HH:mm. Or durationMinutes. Default: one hour.

eventId.description: attachment only: the event (from list_events) to attach to. Leave out for key attachments.

startTime.description: event only: HH:mm, 24-hour, in that day's time zone.

unscheduled.description: event only: true puts it in the unscheduled list (no day or time).

tools.name: add_inspiration_to
